definitions.explanation: The time of day right now. A common label on clocks, displays, websites, and transit information showing the present moment.

examples.japanese: {現在時刻|げんざいじこく}は{午後|ごご}{三時|さんじ}です。
{画面|がめん}に{現在時刻|げんざいじこく}が{表示|ひょうじ}される。
examples.english: The current time is displayed on the screen.

examples.japanese: アプリを{開|ひら}くと、{世界|せかい}{各地|かくち}の{現在時刻|げんざいじこく}をすぐに{確認|かくにん}できる。
examples.english: When you open the app, you can immediately check the current time in places around the world.

notes:
Formed from {現在|げんざい} (present, now) + {時刻|じこく} (point in time). A set phrase used wherever the present clock time is shown or announced.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {現在時刻|げんざいじこく}を{確認|かくにん}する: to check the current time
- {現在時刻|げんざいじこく}を{表示|ひょうじ}する: to display the current time

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {時刻|じこく}: point in time — a specific moment on the clock, not necessarily the present one
- {現時点|げんじてん}: the present point — refers to "as of now" in a broader sense, not just the clock time
